digest.component_or_area: code-review gate, LLM runner model routing
propositions: Every LLM call in the code-review gate executes with cfg.model regardless of per-step model declarations, despite both step-level (prompt steps) and batch-level (batch.model_ladder) declarations being present in code-review.yaml and reaching the interpreter intact.

PydanticAIRunner.run constructs a cfg from self._config and uses that for all resolution, discarding the per-step model value carried in req.config.model, making per-call model overrides inert at the runner layer.

Step-level model declarations are correctly parsed, resolved, and threaded into RunRequest.config by RunnerAgentStep and CodeReviewBatchRunner, but are never consulted downstream when the model is actually invoked.

Usage logging lacks per-step attribution, recording only the prompt name (op), which cannot distinguish base-step calls from batch-finder calls using the same prompt, making defects unobservable without instrumentation changes.
